editorial.meta_description: The ServiceNow CIS-Finance exam validates your professional skills in finance service configuration, invoice processing, and supply chain management workflows
editorial.overview: The ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Finance and Supply Chain (CIS-Finance) exam evaluates your ability to implement and configure finance and supply chain operations. Certified by ServiceNow, this exam covers three primary domains: Finance Service Configuration, Invoice and Payment Processing, and Supply Chain Management. It confirms your technical proficiency in managing these complex workflows on the ServiceNow platform, ensuring you can effectively deploy solutions that meet organizational requirements for finance and supply chain management excellence.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam is intended for implementation specialists and technical consultants who configure finance and supply chain solutions. Candidates should have experience with ServiceNow platform administration and practical knowledge of procurement, supplier lifecycle, and accounts payable workflows.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official ServiceNow exam guide and study documentation available on Now Learning. Focus on understanding the configuration of Source-to-Pay Operations, including procurement, supplier onboarding, and invoice processing. Practice using the Source-to-Pay Workspace and review the plugin installation sequences for SPO, SLO, and APO. Ensure you are familiar with the end-to-end purchasing and sourcing workflows described in the official documentation to prepare for the 60 questions.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the setup and configuration of finance services within the ServiceNow platform, focusing on the specific architecture required to support finance and supply chain operations effectively for all enterprise users.

This domain focuses on the automation and management of invoice and payment processes, including the integration of accounts payable workflows and the handling of complex financial exceptions within the system for business operations.

This domain addresses the management of supply chain activities, including sourcing, procurement, and supplier lifecycle operations within the ServiceNow environment to ensure efficient and streamlined business process execution for all global organizations.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The exam consists of 60 questions in a linear format. You will have 90 minutes to complete the test. Manage your time effectively across the three domains to ensure you address all questions within the allotted duration.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam contains 60 questions in a linear format, requiring you to answer multiple choice and multiple select items. You must manage your time carefully to address every question within the allotted testing period.

The passing score for the CIS-Finance exam is 70. Candidates must achieve this minimum score or higher to successfully earn their certification and demonstrate their proficiency in the subject matter.
The exam is a 90-minute exam. You should plan to arrive early and ensure you are prepared to focus for the entire duration of the test to complete all required sections.

faq.question_title: What is the cost of the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam price is 150 dollars. This fee covers the cost of the certification attempt and must be paid through the official ServiceNow portal prior to scheduling your exam appointment date.

faq.question_title: How long is the certification valid?
faq.answer_text: The certification is valid for 1 year from the date of passing. You must complete the required delta exam or renewal process within that timeframe to maintain your active status.

methodology.summary: This page was built by synthesizing official ServiceNow exam guides and technical documentation to provide a clear overview of the CIS-Finance certification requirements and domain focus for all candidates.
